preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board and the number of chips must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n and 1 <= sy_i <= m for sx_i, sy_i in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions of the chips must be valid coordinates within the board.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx_i <= n and 1 <= fy_i <= m for fx_i, fy_i in target_positions)
preconditions.description: All target positions for the chips must be valid coordinates within the board.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(operations) <= 2 * n * m and all(chip_visits_target(chip, operations) for chip in chips))
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence of operations exists, it must not exceed 2nm actions and each chip must visit its target position at least once.
If a valid sequence of operations exists, it must contain at least one operation.
